title: Emphasis tests are red
prompts: The inline formatting tests are failing in this repo after a refactor of the inline parser. Find what broke and fix the source so the whole suite passes. Do not edit, skip or delete any tests.
notes: Three regressions in src/parser/inline.js: intraword underscore check dropped, the *** run capped at two, and * and _ removed from the escapable set. Three visible tests fail (two in inline.test.js, plus the intraword-underscore case in inline-intraword.test.js); grading replaces test/ with the original suite plus four more cases.
